newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians stone soldiers in Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians stone soldiers in Hebron.

text.p: Palestinians stoned Israeli soldiers in Hebron on Tuesday, but they held fire and there were no casualties, Palestinian sources said.

About 70 protesters stoned the soldiers in front of a hospital in the West Bank city at 0700 GMT, when a break of several hours in a curfew was about to end. The soldiers then chased and dispersed the protesters.

Hebron, a flashpoint of Arab-Jewish violence, was under curfew during last week's fierce gunbattles and clashes between Palestinians and Israelis in the West Bank and Gaza Strip in which 55 Palestinians and 15 Israelis were killed.
The city is expected to figure prominently at a Washington summit on Tuesday and Wednesday called to end the violence.

Palestinians want Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to implement an agreement on redeploying Israeli troops in Hebron that was signed with Israel's previous government ousted by Netanyahu in May elections.
